title: Designing an Integrated Learning Ecosystem for Introductory Python Programming: Scaffolded Problem Solving, Tablet-Inspired Navigation, and AI-Enhanced Instruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.33471v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Introductory programming requires students to represent problems, develop and test programs, debug errors, and apply computational ideas in new contexts. In this paper, we present an artifact-centered design analysis of an integrated learning ecosystem developed for a 16-lab introductory Python course. The analyzed corpus comprises 18 instructional artifacts: the course syllabus, a tablet-inspired homepage, and Labs 1-16. We examined course navigation, problem representation, scaffolding, independent transfer, application development, debugging, AI integration, and assessment. All 15 scaffolded labs shared seven elements: input-processing-output (IPO) reasoning, instructor-guided programming, an independent task, a Google Colab/Gradio extension, debugging support, a task checklist, and submission requirements. translated_title: 面向Python入门编程的集成学习生态系统设计：支架式问题解决、平板风格导航与AI增强教学
translated_abstract: 入门编程要求学生表征问题、开发和测试程序、调试错误，并在新情境中应用计算思想。本文对为一个包含16个实验课时的Python入门课程开发的集成学习生态系统进行了以教学工件为中心的设计分析。所分析的语料库包含18个教学工件：课程大纲、一个平板风格的主页以及实验1至16。我们考察了课程导航、问题表征、支架设计、独立迁移、应用开发、调试、AI集成与评估。全部15个支架式实验课共享七个要素：输入-处理-输出（IPO）推理、教师指导式编程、独立任务、基于Google Colab/Gradio的扩展、调试支持、任务清单以及提交要求。实验16脱离了这一结构，作为一项综合性的基于Pygame的特色大作业。该分析识别出四个相互关联的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文为Python入门课程设计并分析了一个集成学习生态系统，其中15个实验课共享IPO推理、教师指导编程、独立任务、Colab/Gradio扩展、调试支持、任务清单与提交要求七大支架要素，并以Pygame综合大作业和AI增强教学、平板风格导航作为支撑。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a design analysis of an integrated learning ecosystem for an introductory Python course, in which 15 scaffolded labs share seven common elements (IPO reasoning, instructor-guided programming, independent tasks, Colab/Gradio extensions, debugging support, checklists, and submission requirements), culminating in an integrative Pygame capstone assignment alongside tablet-inspired navigation and AI-enhanced instruction.
